name: aigw-models
description: Experimental and unofficial, not affiliated with or supported by Databricks: signs in to a Databricks AI Gateway and exposes the approved Claude models to VS Code chat and Claude Code.

aiGateway.accountHost.description: Databricks account console host used for the OAuth sign-in.

aiGateway.accountId.description: Databricks account ID (UUID) that owns the AI Gateway workspaces. Required.

aiGateway.workspaceFilter.description: Only account workspaces whose name contains this text (case-insensitive) are offered. Set to an empty string to list every workspace.

aiGateway.redirectPort.description: Loopback port for the OAuth redirect. Must stay 8020 unless Databricks has allowlisted another port for the databricks-cli client.

aiGateway.maxInputTokens.description: Context window advertised to VS Code chat for the base models. The gateway does not report per-model limits, so this is a local declaration. The separate "(1M context)" entries declare 872000 themselves and ignore this setting.

aiGateway.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens advertised to VS Code chat.

aiGateway.offerOneMContext.description: Also offer a "(1M context)" entry for each model the gateway serves with the 1M context window. The gateway routes that window as a separate model id (a [1m] suffix) and does not advertise it, so these entries are added locally. Turn this off if the workspace is not entitled to the 1M window.

aiGateway.configureClaudeCodeOnSignIn.description: After a successful sign-in, point Claude Code at the gateway by writing an apiKeyHelper into the user Claude settings and exporting ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL into new integrated terminals.

aiGateway.tokenServicePort.description: Loopback port for the short-lived token service that Claude Code's apiKeyHelper calls. 0 picks a free port on each activation.

scripts.package: npm run build -- --minify && vsce package --no-dependencies -o aigw-models.vsix
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
